szoveg_eredeti:
We've added Agent monitors to the Monitor API.

An Agent monitor accepts a task in plain language, runs the Agent API on a schedule, and sends an alert with sources when the answer changes.

Search and Page monitors watch a query or URLs you already know.

When a source is not known, an Agent monitor finds it and sends an update when the answer changes.

Example: "Tell me when this laptop drops below $900 at any major retailer."

 https://lnkd.in/gW7ziKtT 

Create and manage monitors in your code, or directly in the API console.

Get started: https://lnkd.in/g8EemYVV
